subject: Zephyr connector gating + billing hooks — marketplace launch asks
messages:
From: Aditi Rao <aditi@zephyr-analytics.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Holt <marcus.holt@zephyr-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-12-11T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Intro + AWS/Azure marketplace lift for Zephyr connector

Hi Rishi / Ben —

Thanks again for taking the meeting this week. As discussed, Zephyr (analytics platform for customer feedback) is aiming to list a managed connector that calls Redwood-hosted models via our API and wants to appear on AWS Marketplace and Azure Marketplace by end of Q1. A few immediate asks so we can finalize our internal roadmap: 

- Entitlement model: Zephyr sells both SaaS seats and per-token billed add-ons. We need guidance on how Redwood expects marketplace entitlement mapping to behave (pass-through vs. Redwood-managed usage).
- Billing hooks: can Redwood emit usage hooks or invoices to support downstream chargeback? If not, what metadata do you need from our side?
- Onboarding gating: We have a security questionnaire ready; are there specific docs or scoping exceptions required for the private deployment option?

I've attached a high-level dataflow and our proposed entitlement matrix. Happy to set up a short call with your marketplace ops folks.

Best,
Aditi
Head of Partnerships, Zephyr Analytics

Attachment: zephyr-dataflow-diagram.png (image/png)
Attachment: zephyr-entitlement-matrix.csv (text/csv)
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Aditi Rao <aditi@zephyr-analytics.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-11T11:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + AWS/Azure marketplace lift for Zephyr connector

Hi Aditi —

Appreciate the summary. Quick replies to unblock you: 

- Entitlements: we support both pass-through and Redwood-billed options. For marketplace listings we typically recommend pass-through for ISVs that want direct billing via AWS/Azure, but Redwood-billed gives tighter control over quota enforcement. If you want both markets supported, we should identify a single canonical entitlement key (customer_id + sku) and a fallback policy.

- Billing hooks: Redwood can emit a webhook with aggregated usage daily and we can include token-level breakdowns if you opt in. Alternatively, we can provide a monthly CSV export. We need the field mapping from your side (customer_id, sku, marketplace_order_id).

- Onboarding gating: for Private deployments we require SOC2 scope notes and your data retention policy; for hosted listings the standard marketplace security questionnaire + signed NDA is usually sufficient.

Looping in Laura (product) and Ben (partner eng) to scope the work and propose a minimal gate for an initial listing vs. full GA.

Action: Can you confirm which billing mode you prefer and share a sample order_id format by end of next week?

Thanks,
Rishi
Director, Partner Integrations
Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Aditi Rao <aditi@zephyr-analytics.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-12T08:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + AWS/Azure marketplace lift for Zephyr connector

Hi all —

Thanks Aditi, this looks doable. A couple product notes and proposed timeline: 

- Minimal listing (MVP): pass-through billing via marketplace order ids, simple entitlement check (order_id -> customer_id mapping). No special quota enforcement beyond standard per-tenant limits. Target: quick listing in 6–8 weeks.
- GA listing: option for Redwood-billed usage with token-level metering, quota enforcement, and SLA. Target: 3 months (requires billing integration + regression evals).

Open questions for Zephyr: 
1) Do you require per-feature metering (e.g., ingestion vs. query tokens)? If yes, include flags in the entitlement matrix.
2) For private deployment option, do you plan to use KMS/HSM keys or Redwood-managed keys? That changes onboarding docs we provide.

I'll draft an MVP checklist and share by EOD tomorrow.

-Laura
Product Manager, Marketplace Integrations
Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditi Rao <aditi@zephyr-analytics.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-13T09:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + AWS/Azure marketplace lift for Zephyr connector

Hi Aditi / team —

From an engineering standpoint, a few practical asks to include in the entitlement matrix: 
- canonical_customer_id (UUID) that maps to marketplace order IDs
- sku tag on each API call (header: X-ZEPP-SKU) so we can attribute tokens
- optional feature flag (header: X-ZEPP-FEATURE) for per-feature billing

We can provide a webhook schema for daily aggregated usage exports. If you want near-real-time chargeback, we should scope rate limits and expected payload sizes.

Estimated effort: 2 sprints to add header parsing + mapping + export pipeline (MVP). If you want Redwood-billed invoicing, add ~2 more sprints for billing reconciliation and QA.

Ben
Senior Integration Engineer
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Intro + AWS/Azure marketplace lift for Zephyr connector

Team —

I ran this past marketplace compliance. A few operational items to add to the checklist: 

- AWS Marketplace: we need a signed commercial terms addendum and your billing contact for AWS-Seller Central. I'll reach out to marketplace-ops@amazon.com for a pre-check.
- Azure: request isv-onboarding@microsoft.com will need an entitlement mapping doc and your Marketplace ID.
- Legal: we received Zephyr's NDA (thanks) but need the SOC2 report or attestation for Private deployments. If SOC2 is in progress, provide scope and expected completion date.

I've attached a procurement checklist template and added a column for exceptions we can grant for MVP listings (e.g., no per-feature metering initially).

Attachment: zephyr-nda-signed.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: procurement-marketplace-checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Karthik

Thanks everyone — good progress. Summary + actions: 

1) Zephyr to confirm billing mode by 2026-12-21 (pass-through MVP recommended). Please reply to this thread with a sample marketplace order id format (Aditi).
2) Ben: scope headers + webhook schema; deliver draft by 2026-12-20.
3) Laura: share MVP checklist (product) by EOD 2026-12-14.
4) Karthik: open marketplace pre-checks with AWS/Azure and confirm any commercial addenda needed.
5) Zephyr to share SOC2 status or attestation (for private deployment) and any KMS preferences.

I'll create a short mutual action plan in HubSpot and add deadlines. Thanks Aditi — once we have the order_id format we'll kick off a 2-sprint engineering workstream for the MVP.

Rishi
Director, Partner Integrations
Redwood Inference
